Kit summary

Spring FlameBasic
Attacks a single enemy, dealing [Burn] DMG equal to 15% of Brigid's Max HP to the target, with a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Burn] on the target for 2 turns. Afterward, restores HP equal to 15% of Brigid's Max HP to the ally with the lowest HP percentage.
Blooming InfernoActiveExclusive Lv.1
Attacks the primary enemy target and 2 random targets, dealing [Burn] DMG equal to 15% of Brigid's Max HP. Afterward, grants [Spark Ward] to all allies (Mastery RES +50%, Tenacity +50%) for 2 turns.
Blooming Splendor Lv.1When casting Blooming Inferno, grants [SPD Up II] to all allies for 4 turns. [Life Judgment]'s Max HP reduction is increased to 3%, and each time it triggers, additionally restores HP equal to 3% of Brigid's Max HP to all allies.
Spring VitalityPassiveExclusive Lv.3
While Brigid is on the battlefield, she has both [Spirit Flame Resonance] and [Life Judgment]. [Spirit Flame Resonance]: When dealing [Burn] DMG, additionally deals [HP Deduction] DMG equal to 7% of the target's Max HP, caps at 15% of Brigid's Max HP. [Life Judgment]: Each time an ally deals [HP Deduction] DMG, reduces the target's Max HP by 2% for 2 turns, up to 10 layers; this effect does not apply to Boss targets.
Blooming Splendor Lv.3At the start of battle, for each ally with the [HP Deduction] tag deployed, grants [Spring Bloom] to all allies. [Spring Bloom]: Increases Max HP by 8%; reduces Basic Attack DMG taken and Skill DMG taken by 12%. For each ally with the [Burn] or [HP Burning] tag deployed, grants [Blazing Surge] to all allies. [Blazing Surge]: Increases [Burn] DMG and [HP Burning] DMG by 12%. When 5 allies with the [HP Deduction] tag are deployed, grants [DMG Immunity] and [Control Immunity] to all allies for 2 turns. If only 1 enemy remains on the field, inflicts [Perish] (cannot trigger the resurrection effects from Basic Attacks and Skills) on that enemy.
Bloom and BlazeActiveExclusive Lv.2
Removes all buffs from all enemies, then deals [Burn] DMG equal to 15% of Brigid's Max HP, with a 100% chance to inflict [Loong's Wrath] (does not stack with [HP Burning]; DMG dealt is considered [HP Burning] DMG) for 2 turns. Afterward, gains [Revival Field] for 2 turns. [Revival Field]: When an ally acts, restores HP equal to 20% of Brigid's Max HP to them; if an ally within the field dies, immediately revives them at 100% Max HP and resets all their skill CDs, the field is immediately removed once this effect ends and cannot have its duration reduced by other effects.
Blooming Splendor Lv.2When casting Bloom and Blaze, grants [HP UP II] and [ATK Up II] to all allies for 4 turns. The duration of [Revival Field] is increased to 4 turns. Upon gaining [Revival Field], inflicts [Cinder] (Mastery RES and Tenacity reduced by 30%) on enemies within the field. If [Revival Field] expires naturally with no allied deaths, grants [Revival Shield] to all allies for 2 turns. [Revival Shield]: Gains a Shield equal to 30% of Brigid's Max HP; the owner is immune to all control effects.
